vscode.release-flow.never-released-no-ve: never released: no version to bump
vscode.release-flow.smith-refuses-to-for: smith refuses to force it. To choose its first version, commit: {firstVersionCommand}
vscode.release-flow.no-package-is-releas: no package is released without a releasing commit
vscode.release-flow.release-it-anyway-th: Release it anyway: the same code under a new version. It creates a tag at HEAD, publishes to the registry, makes a GitHub Release and cannot be undone.
vscode.release-flow.release-a-package-wi: {title}: release a package without a releasing commit?
vscode.release-flow.pick-a-package-to-re: Pick a package to release it anyway, or continue without one.
vscode.release-flow.monosmith-was-never-: MonoSmith: {name} was never released, so there is no version to bump.
vscode.release-flow.to-choose-its-first-:
To choose its first version, make a commit whose subject is version({name})[x.y.z]:

{firstVersionCommand}
vscode.release-flow.no-commit-releases-i: {names}: no commit releases it. The new tag points at HEAD, and the same code is published under a new version, with a GitHub Release and the assets.
vscode.release-flow.monosmith-smith-was-: MonoSmith: smith was not found for {name}, so nothing can be released. Install smith, then run "MonoSmith: Release…" again.
vscode.release-flow.monosmith-releasing-: MonoSmith: releasing {name}… smith tags and publishes.
vscode.release-flow.monosmith-this-is-wh: MonoSmith: this is what a release would do now.
vscode.release-flow.nothing-is-published:
{plan}

Nothing is published yet. Next you can hold packages back and change a bump. After that comes the last question.
vscode.release-flow.hold-it-back-it-does: Hold it back: it does not release this time. A package that releases only because of it is held back too.
vscode.release-flow.tick-the-packages-th: Tick the packages that must not release this time. Enter with nothing ticked releases them all.
vscode.release-flow.keep-the-bumps-as-th: $(check) Keep the bumps as they are
vscode.release-flow.change-its-bump-a-re: Change its bump: a request, not an inference. On a 0.x package, major gives 1.0.0.
vscode.release-flow.pick-a-package-to-ch: Pick a package to change its level, or keep them all.
vscode.release-flow.this-cannot-be-undon:
{plan}{held}{bumped}{forcedConsequences}

This cannot be undone. smith creates the tags, pushes them and publishes the packages to the registries. Undo does not revert it.
vscode.release-flow.no-commit-releases-w: No commit releases {join}. "Without a commit…" releases one anyway: the same code under a new version.
vscode.release-flow.a-package-releases-w: A package releases when a commit since its last tag asks for it.
vscode.release-flow.monosmith-open-previ: MonoSmith: {first} {why} "Open Preview" opens the Release Preview, which says why.
vscode.release-flow.open-the-release-pre: Open the Release Preview view: it says why nothing releases and what to do.
vscode.release-flow.choose-a-package-to-: Choose a package to release although no commit releases it. It creates a tag at HEAD, publishes, and cannot be undone.
vscode.release-flow.smith-printed-the-re: smith printed the release plan in a form this editor does not read. Update the extension, or run smith release in a terminal.
